summary: Dual-LLM benchmarking infrastructure: fixtures, runner, auditor and oracle

delivery.outcome: Create the Dual-LLM benchmarking infrastructure: 8 disposable fixtures matching the standard scenarios, a Python runner that calls OpenRouter API for executor models, a blind auditor script, a deterministic oracle, and receipt templates. No model runs are executed in this ticket — that is deferred to a dependent ticket after infrastructure review.
nonGoals: Execute actual model runs (deferred to dependent ticket)
Modify SOP spec files or schemas
Create external network effects or API calls during tests

architecture.decision: Create the benchmarking infrastructure as test-only artifacts under tests/dual_llm/. Fixtures are disposable local repos with no credentials. Runner uses OpenRouter API (openai/gpt-chat-latest and google/gemini-3.6-flash) via OPENROUTER_API_KEY from subllm/.env. Auditor is blind to executor identity. Oracle is deterministic Python.
interfaceChanges: Introduce tests/dual_llm/ as the benchmarking infrastructure directory
architecture.rollback: Discard unmerged ticket branch and revert to baseline.
